name: session-coordination
description: Per-session CLI and sidecar control paths that declare work to Concordia while keeping optional observability outside the control dependency chain.
cardTemplate: Summarise the session-coordination domain: task declaration remains available independently of optional observability artifacts.
specRefs: タスク宣言プロトコル
セットアップ — 観測 (Vestigium) は best-effort
rationale: Short-lived task commands belong to the session-control path and must not import the optional Vestigium build artifact. Long-running providers may initialize the adapter at their entry boundary without making observability a prerequisite for task declaration.
